t: The Hager WMDRP2KIT 2-gang modular dimmer switch kit provides reliable lighting control for various electrical installations. This whitel rotary dimmer with a screwed faceplate ensures a secure fit. Supplied with a plate, matching buttons, and M3.5 x 30mm fixing screws with screw covers, this kit is compatible with most D shaft push and rotary dimmer modules, making it a versatile choice for electrical contractors and trade professionals.
b: Suitable for Most D Shaft Push & Rotary Dimmer Switch Modules
